response.sql: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count FROM district AS d LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), regional_counts AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg FROM district_counts), above_average AS (SELECT * FROM regional_counts WHERE account_count > region_avg) SELECT district_id, region, account_count, account_count - region_avg AS above_region_average, 1.0 * account_count / AVG(account_count) OVER () AS ratio FROM above_average ORDER BY ratio DESC, district_id LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Every district on file contributes to its region’s average, including districts with zero accounts.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate each region’s average using only districts that have at least one account.
